versions.subject: Merge PR #5928 from @swachchhanda000 - Add Axios NPM Compromise Indicators Related Rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
        - '\node.exe'
        - '\powershell.exe'
selection_fils:
    - TargetFilename:
          - 'C:\ProgramData\wt.exe'
          - 'C:\ProgramData\system.bat'
    - TargetFilename|contains|all:
          - 'C:\Users\'
          - '\AppData\Local\Temp\6202033.vbs'
    - TargetFilename|contains|all:
          - 'C:\Users\'
          - '\AppData\Local\Temp\6202033.ps1'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image IN ("*\\node.exe", "*\\powershell.exe") TargetFilename IN ("C:\\ProgramData\\wt.exe", "C:\\ProgramData\\system.bat") OR (TargetFilename="*C:\\Users\\*" TargetFilename="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\6202033.vbs*") OR (TargetFilename="*C:\\Users\\*" TargetFilename="*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\6202033.ps1*")
